service.en: Utility account certificate (to whom it may concern)
service.ur: یوٹیلیٹی اکاؤنٹ سرٹیفکیٹ (متعلقہ افراد کے نام)

about: Get a certificate confirming you hold an active water and electricity account, with account and premises details.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Power of attorney and the agent's Emirates ID, if applying through an agent

For businesses: economic licence, signature authorisation, authorised signatory's Emirates ID and passport, official letter from the owner with contact details, and a request letter signed by all partners with their Emirates IDs
timing: Documents are needed only if required for the channel used
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app) or another available channel
